messages:
kai_new: hey all  first week q: my phone arrived but the MDM prompt keeps failing at the "device attestation" step. i can't complete corp email setup until that's done. did someone forget to whitelist my device serial? tagging @megan_peopleops and @tyler_it

megan_peopleops: welcome kai! :wave: sorry about that. can you share the device serial from Settings > General > About? we'll escalate. also FYI new hires should expect the phishing sim on day 4 after account creation.

kai_new: serial S/N: C02XQ1234567. i get an "attestation failed: unknown key" error.

tyler_it: thanks. i'm checking the enrollment logs now. if attestation fails it's usually because the TPM/secure enclave wasn't provisioned on the image. i'll try re-pushing the enrollment profile.

mdm-bot: Enrollment job queued for device C02XQ1234567. Job ID: mdm-2026-0457.

sofia_security: quick policy note: mobile devices that fail attestation cannot access corp email or VPN split-tunnel. that's to prevent data leakage. Tyler, if re-enroll works please confirm so we can remove the block.

tyler_it: re-push started at 1781234380. Kai, you'll see a "Company Enrollment" prompt and an OTA attestation popup. accept both and keep Wi-Fi on.

kai_new: saw the prompt, accepted. got a new error "Conditional Access: device not compliant". i completed the privacy screen but still blocked from Outlook.

sofia_security: Conditional Access checks bitlocker/FileVault, device policy, and device posture (password length, encryption). for macs we require FileVault and Gatekeeper enabled. did you toggle FileVault earlier?

kai_new: i enabled FileVault manually before docking the laptop. could that cause a conflict?

tyler_it: enabling FileVault manually can be fine but if it was done before MDM escrow we need to capture the recovery key. i'll initiate a recovery-key escrow task; you'll be prompted to create a local recovery password or allow MDM escrow. choose MDM escrow so we can recover if needed.

megan_peopleops: FYI new hires also have to complete the "Security & Compliance: Quickstart" micro-module in Okta Learn within 72 hours. it's short (~20m) and covers phishing sim expectations and device rules.

security-bot: PhishSim: user kai_new enrolled. scheduled sim: 2026-03-28 14:00 UTC. Please complete the awareness module to avoid automated follow-ups.

kai_new: thanks team. one more: i heard about "split-tunnel disabled" for contractors. are full-time new hires allowed split-tunnel VPN?

sofia_security: full-time employees get split-tunnel enabled for trusted SaaS domains (docs.redwood.com, dev.redwood.local). contractors and high-risk roles have split-tunnel disabled. if you need access to internal-only services use the full-tunnel dev VPN.

tyler_it: update: MDM enroll + attestation completed at 1781234665. Conditional Access cleared. Kai, you should be able to add Outlook and authenticate now. I'll also escrow FileVault recovery.

kai_new: Outlook connected! thanks everyone. also got the MDM welcome checklist email and the MFA reminder.

security-bot: MFA Reminder: complete enrollment within 24 hours to avoid access delays.

megan_peopleops: awesome. ping here if anything else blocks onboarding. and welcome again :tada:

kai_new: appreciate the help  good to be here :)
